end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one ten-bundle and loose ones.
Saanvi counted the ten-bundle as one item instead of ten when finding the total.
Practised identifying the ones digit in teen numbers.
Saanvi wrote 41 for fourteen; the digit-order mix-up was not corrected by the last seen attempt.
end.parentNote: Asha practised teen numbers using a ten-bundle and loose sticks, and connected the spoken number to its two digits. Saanvi explained that a bundle and three sticks made 4, showing the bundle-counting mix-up; it was not corrected later in the lesson. Saanvi also wrote 41 for fourteen, so at home you can build 14 with one group of ten and four single objects, then say and write 14 together.
